title: CounterfactualResult
description: Result of counterfactual simulation with per-recipient impact predictions and blocking decisions. Used for proactive safety (prevent harmful sharing/notifications). Reference: ADR-0012i (k003i)

action_type.description: Type of action that was simulated

overall_safe.description: Whether action is safe for ALL recipients (false if any blocked)

predicted_valence_delta.description: Predicted change in valence: new_valence - current_valence

predicted_arousal_delta.description: Predicted change in arousal: new_arousal - current_arousal

safe.description: Whether action is safe for this recipient (false if any safety rule violated)

violated_rules.description: Safety rules violated (only present if safe=false)

confidence.description: Confidence in prediction (0.0-1.0). Lower confidence may require manual review.

blocked_recipients.description: Person IDs of recipients for whom action is blocked (safe=false)

allowed_recipients.description: Person IDs of recipients for whom action is safe (safe=true)

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of decision (e.g., 'Blocked for 2 recipients: would push into RED band during household conflict')

computed_at.description: Unix timestamp when simulation was computed
